title: Constitutional On-Policy Safe Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.03089v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm by using a teacher conditioned on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. Prior work has shown that OPSD can collapse in verifiable reasoning tasks, while safety alignment differs in that it is guided by high-level constitutions rather than explicit target answers. However, pilot studies reveals that safety OPSD nonetheless suffers from severe collapse, where constitutional conditioning contracts the teacher distribution toward short and overly conservative responses and Reverse KL further amplifies this contraction into reduced expressiveness. We formalize this effect as geometric leakage under safety boundaries in a non-orthogonal semantic space, where safety pressure transfers into the expressiveness dimension. translated_title: 宪法性在线策略安全蒸馏
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.03089v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）已成为一种高效的后训练范式，通过利用基于特权信息条件的教师模型提供密集的令牌级监督。先前工作表明，OPSD在可验证推理任务中可能崩溃，而安全对齐则不同，它由高层宪法而非明确目标答案指导。然而，试点研究表明，安全OPSD仍遭受严重崩溃，其中宪法条件将教师分布收缩至短且过度保守的响应，而反向KL进一步放大这种收缩，导致表达能力降低。我们将此效应形式化为非正交语义空间中安全边界下的几何泄漏，其中安全压力转移到表达能力维度。基于此分析，我们提出宪法性在线策略安全蒸馏（COPSD），首先进行校准。
tldr: 本文提出COPSD方法，通过形式化安全蒸馏中的“几何泄漏”效应，解决了在线策略自蒸馏在安全对齐中因宪法条件导致的表达力崩溃问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes COPSD, which addresses the expressiveness collapse in on-policy self-distillation for safety alignment by formalizing the "geometric leakage" effect under safety boundaries.
